quarterly_data.signal: Material information: on 10/02/2026 the board approved a capital expenditure project for the Kaohsiung branch. To respond to revenue growth, Lite-On plans to expand the Kaohsiung branch's capacity by purchasing production equipment and carrying out plant mechanical and electrical works, a total of NT$88.5 hundred million; counterparties and amounts will be announced once the transactions are determined.
quarterly_data.figure: NT$88.5 hundred million Kaohsiung branch capex (production equipment and plant mechanical and electrical works)
